slot.brief: Compute [a b c] for given vectors or show coplanarity/volume via determinant; moderate arithmetic, possibly with a parameter to find.

stem: For $\vec a=\hat i+\hat j+\hat k$, $\vec b=\hat i+2\hat k$ and $\vec c=2\hat i-2\hat j$, the scalar triple product $[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]$ is

verdicts.working: \([\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)\), with \(\vec b\times\vec c=(4,4,-2)\). Thus the product is \((1,1,1)\cdot(4,4,-2)=6\).

working:
$\vec b\times\vec c=4\hat i+4\hat j-2\hat k$; $[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)=4+4-2=6$.

Independent check: \([\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)\), with \(\vec b\times\vec c=(4,4,-2)\). Thus the product is \((1,1,1)\cdot(4,4,-2)=6\).
solution:
Using $[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=\vec a\cdot(\vec b\times\vec c)$, we get
$$\vec b\times\vec c=4\hat i+4\hat j-2\hat k.$$
Hence $[\vec a\,\vec b\,\vec c]=(1,1,1)\cdot(4,4,-2)=4+4-2=6$.
